findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_a_feature, report_a_bug · Private data: request_a_feature, report_a_bug · Public sink: assessment_ratio_by_area, request_a_feature · Destructive: property_tax_appeal_dates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_a_feature, report_a_bug · Private data: request_a_feature, report_a_bug · Public sink: assessment_ratio_by_area, request_a_feature · Destructive: property_tax_appeal_dates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
